summary: @onereach/idw-sdk preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-tagged blob with string-array rotation (WV8StW rotating n7gIxM), hex-numeric identifiers, and a custom charset decoder (hc1jfK9), unrelated to the package's declared purpose (typed HTTP client for the IDW API). Neither the downloaded Bun archive nor math_init.js is hash/signature-verified. Bun is fetched purely to execute this opaque local blob — Node is already running the installer script — which evades Node-only static inspection because the payload runs under a separately-fetched runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
